text: Capitalizing on the success of its live-action “Cinderella,” Disney has purchased a script by Elizabeth Martin and Lauren Hynek for a live-action retelling of “Mulan,” based on the 1998 animated film about Hua Mulan, a young woman who disguises herself as a man to fight in the army. Chris Bender and J.C. Spink are producing the project.
